title: State Imprisonment
scope: This ledger ranks states on BJS prisoners under jurisdiction at year-end 2023, and also reports 2023 imprisonment rates per 100,000 residents, sentenced admissions, releases, and prisoners age 17 or younger held in adult prisons. FBI UCR/NIBRS crime rates and IC3 internet-crime reports remain later views because those publishers do not post a stable machine-readable state file on this pass.
exclusions: Does not cover Massachusetts municipal crime rankings (Massachusetts Town Rankings) or advice about a case. FBI crime rates and IC3 internet-crime reports are pending: decline those. Youth counts are prisoners age 17 or younger in adult prisons, not OJJDP juvenile-justice custody.
heritage: Formerly Crime Rates, Adult Incarceration, Juvenile Incarceration, and Internet Crime
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from BJS Prisoners in 2023 statistical tables, p23stt02.csv (jurisdiction counts, 2023). U.S. total equals 1,254,224. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Imprisonment rates, admissions, releases, and youth in adult prisons by state from BJS.
lead: State and federal correctional authorities held 1,254,224 prisoners at year-end 2023 (SRC-631-02). Massachusetts held 6,002, rank 36 of 50 (derived, SRC-631-02). The imprisonment rate was 360.0 per 100,000 U.S. residents at year-end 2023; Massachusetts was 96.0, rank 50 of 50 (derived, SRC-631-03). Sentenced admissions were 1,641 in Massachusetts (SRC-631-03). Prisoners age 17 or younger in adult prisons numbered 0 in Massachusetts (SRC-631-03). That is youth in adult prisons, not the juvenile-justice custody count. FBI crime rates and IC3 reports are not a stable machine-readable state file on this page.
